title: Highly available public web platform
problem: Serve a customer-facing application through routine instance and single-AZ failures without exposing application or database hosts directly to the internet.

requirements.availability: 99.9% monthly target with no single-instance dependency
requirements.security: TLS, private compute/data tiers, least privilege, encrypted data and auditable access
requirements.cost: Cost-aware baseline with reliability investments identified separately

architecture.summary: Route 53 and an internet-facing ALB distribute requests to an Auto Scaling group across two private-subnet AZs; managed data services remain isolated and observable.

decisions: Infrastructure and alarms are reviewed as code
Runbooks cover target, AZ and database failures
No inbound SSH or public instance addresses
Managed synchronous database standby for the stated RPO
Scale stateless compute from measured demand
Use caching only after access-pattern measurement
Right-size from utilization and load tests
Use managed services and efficient instance families where requirements permit

failure_modes.impact: Capacity decreases but traffic continues through the remaining healthy target
failure_modes.mitigation: Auto Scaling replaces the target and the ALB routes only to healthy instances
failure_modes.prevention: Minimum multi-instance capacity, health checks and replacement testing

failure_modes.impact: Load shifts to remaining AZ and may approach capacity limits
failure_modes.detection: AZ-aware target, latency, error and dependency metrics
failure_modes.mitigation: Scale remaining capacity and follow the AZ impairment runbook
failure_modes.prevention: Multi-AZ placement, sufficient failover headroom and game days

decisions.decision: Use an ALB and Auto Scaling group across two AZs
decisions.trade_off: Higher baseline cost than a single host; removes a single compute dependency
decisions.revisit_when: Traffic, latency, protocol, regional or edge requirements change

decisions.decision: Keep instances private and use Systems Manager
decisions.trade_off: Requires controlled egress/endpoints and SSM operational dependency
decisions.revisit_when: Organization access architecture or endpoint policy changes

verification: Load test at normal and failover capacity
Terminate one target and measure recovery
Restore database backup and measure RTO/RPO
Run synthetic HTTP and business-transaction checks
